scope.method: Complete static reading of launcher, result verifier and metadata sealer; exact Git-byte hashing; independent full-string derivation comparison against the original qualifier; final verifier narrow-delta comparison.

protocol.authoritative_pre_execution_decision: Root's final five-stage revision02: clippy, test-build, isolated-tests, audit-isolated-tests, release; omit already completed format/fmt-check/harness calls and do not reformat.
protocol.source_baseline: accepted R24 plus the frozen D1 diagnostic patch

findings.conclusion: Unsealed SPEC rejects before side effects. The actual launcher is externally SHA-bound and verifies the four-file tool inventory, source derivation, manifest and corrected foundation. It reads the independently named ordinary prerequisite file, runs the original full Q/CI binder before same-PID exec, requires the original three-GiB free-space threshold, diagnostic environment absence, and absent ordinary output/plan. The original Q and CI evidence is preserved.

The derived qualifier is exactly the frozen 7661-byte original after deleting three literal all-features arguments and the one 287-byte block invoking format, fmt-check and harness-tests. Every other byte is unchanged. No no-default-features switch, package dependency default/profile change or source rewrite was introduced. The launcher compares TOML outside the sole nondefault diagnostic feature with the accepted baseline.

The import-safe verifier requires the actual original successful ordinary terminal and complete original read pages. It binds the immutable launch plan, full Q/CI proof, five report stages/commands, raw stdout/stderr, actual isolated summary and original audit inputs. Test counts are derived from the ordinary summary, not copied from diagnostic Q. The qualified, ordinary input/tested/after maps must all be the same 222-entry map; all nineteen harness hashes must remain unchanged.

The original complete native stdout must exactly reconcile as JSON rows with the launcher plan hash, five actual stage start/result pairs and final qualified report. Stderr must be empty for this successful prerequisite path. The proof is not synthesized from a stage exit alone.

The prior unexecuted verifier unnecessarily reread every test ELF with a 128-MiB limit. Actual D1 CI report records a retained libtest ELF of 544872376 bytes, so that added cap could reject valid ordinary evidence. The final source removes only that repeated test-ELF body read, verifies fixed retained paths and SHA256 syntax/equal before-after values from the original bound audit, and explicitly reports retained_test_elves_rehashed_by_postflight=false. This follows the original Q binder's custody scope; it does not weaken a runtime test threshold or rerun the auditor.

actual_diagnostic_test_elf_reference.scope: This is the actual diagnostic Q retained ELF recorded by CI, not a claim about the still-unexecuted ordinary ELF.

findings.conclusion: The verifier still rehashes all three separately retained diagnostic release programs and all three separately retained ordinary release programs. The diagnostic copies must equal their launch-plan identities and the fresh Q/CI proof. Ordinary test Cargo artifacts must have an empty package feature list; release uses the exact original command with only the all-features argument removed and the dedicated output mapping.

The sealer performs local identity/JSON work only and writes a fresh package with exclusive files. Launch sealing preserves the full prerequisite bytes, injects only SPEC, binds the original/derived qualifier plus final verifier, and records the future native/result fields as null. Result sealing requires actual original successful documents and pages but leaves full stream/source/ELF validation to the frozen runtime verifier. Neither sealer output nor this review claims ordinary execution or performance acceptance.

The future C1 outer must bind this exact verifier, the actual verification-input file and the actual postflight, revalidate the ordinary proof before quiet/measurement, and retain both release ELF sets. Q/CI success alone cannot satisfy the frozen plan's ordinary prerequisite.

remaining_limits: Static review does not substitute for the first actual ordinary native run and its complete original evidence.
The exact sealed launch package should be checked for the sole SPEC injection and verbatim copied qualifier/verifier/full prerequisite before deployment.
Failure originals remain evidence; this successful prerequisite verifier intentionally cannot authorize C1 from a failed or partial ordinary result.
The previous eight-stage draft and the superseded 128-MiB verifier remain preserved Git objects; neither was executed by this review.
The local executor was unavailable for this review. No target Python source was parsed or executed here; exact-byte derivation and complete static reading were used.
